上传并发送图片（可带说明文字）: Uploads and sends an image (with an optional caption)
上传并发送文件附件: Uploads and sends a file attachment
上游原始消息，形状由 clawbot 决定: The raw upstream message; its shape is determined by clawbot
会话（扫码登录获取）: Session (obtained by scanning a QR code to log in)
向指定 wxid 发送文本消息: Sends a text message to the given wxid
接入微信官方 ClawBot（iLink Bot 接口）：你在微信里给 Claw: Connects WeChat's official ClawBot (iLink Bot API): messaging ClawBot in WeChat triggers a workflow, which can reply with text, images or files. Only the person who bound it by scanning the QR code can chat with it.
消息附带图片（平台文件引用，可多张）: Images attached to the message (platform file references, can be multiple)
消息附带文件（平台文件引用）: Files attached to the message (platform file reference)
点凭证行的「登录/授权」扫码获取，无需手填: Click “Log in / Authorize” on the credential row and scan the QR code to get this; no need to fill it in by hand
缺省用上游文件名: Defaults to the upstream file name
